import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"].copy()
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"].copy()
    payments = db["payments"].copy()

    for col in ["order_purchase_timestamp", "order_approved_at",
                "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date",
                "order_estimated_delivery_date"]:
        if col in orders.columns:
            orders[col] = pd.to_datetime(orders[col], errors="coerce")
    for col in ["shipping_limit_date", "ts"]:
        if col in order_items.columns:
            order_items[col] = pd.to_datetime(order_items[col], errors="coerce")
    for col in ["review_creation_date", "review_answer_timestamp"]:
        if col in reviews.columns:
            reviews[col] = pd.to_datetime(reviews[col], errors="coerce")
    if "ts" in payments.columns:
        payments["ts"] = pd.to_datetime(payments["ts"], errors="coerce")

    base_date = pd.Timestamp(seed_time)

    # --- Строгая фильтрация по времени: используем только события, произошедшие ДО seed_time ---
    order_items_hist = order_items[order_items["ts"] < base_date].copy()
    orders_hist = orders[orders["order_purchase_timestamp"] < base_date].copy()
    # Отзыв известен только если он создан до seed_time
    reviews_hist = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < base_date].copy()
    payments_hist = payments[payments["ts"] < base_date].copy()

    # Информация о доставке известна только если доставка реально произошла до seed_time
    delivered_known = orders_hist[
        (orders_hist["order_status"] == "delivered")
        & (orders_hist["order_delivered_customer_date"] < base_date)
    ].copy()
    delivered_known["delivery_days"] = (
        delivered_known["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        - delivered_known["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).dt.days
    delivered_known["late_delivery"] = (
        delivered_known["order_delivered_customer_date"]
        > delivered_known["order_estimated_delivery_date"]
    ).astype(float)

    # Объединение позиций с заказами (только исторические заказы)
    order_items_full = pd.merge(
        order_items_hist,
        orders_hist[["order_id", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    # Отзывы: мержим только те, что созданы до seed_time
    order_items_reviews = pd.merge(
        order_items_full,
        reviews_hist[["order_id", "review_score"]],
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    payments_agg = payments_hist.groupby("order_id", as_index=False).agg({
        "payment_value": "sum",
        "payment_installments": "max"
    }).rename(columns={
        "payment_value": "total_payment_value",
        "payment_installments": "max_installments"
    })
    order_items_all = pd.merge(
        order_items_reviews,
        payments_agg,
        on="order_id",
        how="left"
    )

    time_windows = [30, 90, 180, 9999]
    features_list = []

    for window in time_windows:
        window_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=window)
        mask = (order_items_all["ts"] >= window_start) & (order_items_all["ts"] < base_date)
        window_data = order_items_all[mask]

        agg_dict = {
            "order_id": "nunique",
            "order_item_id": "count",
            "price": ["mean", "sum", "std"],
            "freight_value": ["mean", "sum"],
            "review_score": ["mean", "std"],
            "total_payment_value": "sum",
            "max_installments": "mean"
        }
        product_agg = window_data.groupby("product_id").agg(agg_dict)
        product_agg.columns = [f"{col[0]}_{col[1]}_w{window}" for col in product_agg.columns]
        features_list.append(product_agg)

    all_features = pd.concat(features_list, axis=1, join="outer")
    all_features = all_features.loc[:, ~all_features.columns.duplicated()]

    # Время с последней/первой продажи (только продажи до seed_time)
    last_sale = order_items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].max()
    all_features["days_since_last_sale"] = (base_date - last_sale).dt.days
    first_sale = order_items_hist.groupby("product_id")["ts"].min()
    all_features["days_since_first_sale"] = (base_date - first_sale).dt.days

    # Признак тренда: продажи в последних 30 днях vs предыдущих 30 днях
    w30_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=30)
    w60_start = base_date - pd.Timedelta(days=60)
    recent = order_items_hist[order_items_hist["ts"] >= w30_start].groupby("product_id").size()
    prev = order_items_hist[
        (order_items_hist["ts"] >= w60_start) & (order_items_hist["ts"] < w30_start)
    ].groupby("product_id").size()
    trend = (recent.reindex(all_features.index).fillna(0)
             - prev.reindex(all_features.index).fillna(0))
    all_features["sales_trend_30v30"] = trend

    # Статистика доставки: только заказы, доставленные ДО seed_time
    if len(delivered_known) > 0:
        delivery_stats = delivered_known.groupby("product_id").agg({
            "delivery_days": ["mean", "std"],
            "late_delivery": "mean"
        })
        delivery_stats.columns = ["delivery_vs_est_mean", "delivery_vs_est_std", "late_rate"]
        all_features = all_features.join(delivery_stats, how="outer")
    else:
        all_features["delivery_vs_est_mean"] = np.nan
        all_features["delivery_vs_est_std"] = np.nan
        all_features["late_rate"] = np.nan

    # Доля отзывов с низкой оценкой (только отзывы, созданные до seed_time)
    low_reviews = reviews_hist[reviews_hist["review_score"] <= 2].groupby("order_id").size()
    order_items_all["is_low_review"] = order_items_all["order_id"].map(low_reviews).fillna(0)
    low_rate = order_items_all.groupby("product_id")["is_low_review"].mean()
    all_features["low_review_rate"] = low_rate

    all_features["is_new_product"] = all_features.isna().all(axis=1).astype(int)

    global_means = all_features.drop(columns=["is_new_product"]).mean()
    all_features = all_features.fillna(global_means)
    all_features = all_features.fillna(0)

    if "price_sum_w90" in all_features.columns:
        total_rev_90 = all_features["price_sum_w90"].sum()
        if total_rev_90 > 0:
            all_features["revenue_share_w90"] = all_features["price_sum_w90"] / total_rev_90
        else:
            all_features["revenue_share_w90"] = 0.0
        all_features["revenue_share_w90"] = all_features["revenue_share_w90"].fillna(0)

    result_df = all_features.reindex(entity_ids)

    if "is_new_product" in result_df.columns:
        result_df["is_new_product"] = result_df["is_new_product"].fillna(1)
    else:
        result_df["is_new_product"] = 1
    result_df = result_df.fillna(0)

    result_df = result_df.select_dtypes(include=[np.number])

    return result_df
